content.short: Namespace provides developer tools and a consumer platform to increase ENS adoption through Subnames.
content.description: To onboard the next billion people to crypto, it's essential to minimize security vulnerabilities and improve the user experience. Replacing long 0x addresses with friendly, human-readable names makes interactions more intuitive and reduces the chance of error. Namespace offers an ENS subname management platform accompanied by a developer toolkit that simplifies subname creation, ownership, and integration. By streamlining ENS adoption and expanding its practical utility across ecosystems, Namespace helps builders and users unlock safer, more scalable identity and naming solutions.
content.meta: Namespace is an ENS Subname management platform and developer toolkit. Discover Namespace and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
